html:
Hello to all my readers out there. Many of you have contacted me to ask when the next book of my epic fantasy series, The Endarian Prophecy, will be released. I am hard at work on it right now and will finish the first draft of what I am currently calling The Shattered Trident by late summer 2018. This novel picks up immediately after Curse of the Chosen and will be the first novel in the series that brings Lorness Carol and Blade into direct conflict against the ancient magic wielder, Kragan, and his allies. This continuing story will also reveal the missing branches of the nine magics, the secret of which lies in a disguised section of the prophecy contained within the Scroll of Landrel.

My publisher has not yet set a release date for the next novel but I will post it here as soon as I know. For you hardy souls who would like to join my group of Beta Readers … who get access to my early Beta Draft and get to have some input into the final shape of the story, just send an email requesting to be added to my Beta Readers List.

email: Richard.Phillips@SecondShip.net

Thank you for reading and supporting my novels.
Best,

Richard

comments.author: Clayton Vernon
comments.html: Hi Richard, I’ve been devouring books left and right in anticipation of your next release and can’t wait for Shattered Trident! While I would dearly love to be a Beta reader I worry that it would take away from the experience of the continuing saga. What do you think?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Clayton,
Being a Beta Reader isn’t for everyone. When I finish the draft that I send to my publisher, I also send it out to my Beta Readers. What they see is the same thing my editor gets before we rework the draft. The story is the same but quite a bit of refinement happens after that. On the plus side, Beta Readers get to have a chance to improve the final story. I’m not really looking for typos, spelling, or miswording errors but on story details or errors that beta readers spot. Things like … I would really like to see more of this… or … I felt this particular fight sequence was too drawn out. Many of my Beta Readers just let me know how they liked the initial draft and then read the final result to see what has changed.

If you decide you want the free Beta Draft, just email me at:
[email removed]
